answer_result.answer: Yes. Dave can work with engines: the evidence says he has done engine swaps, fixed a neighbor's car engine himself, and worked on engine repairs/restorations.

evidence_items.text:
- Appreciates Calvin's encouragement: "It means a lot that my work is valued and that it brings joy to others" [S4T23].
- On 2023-05-03, announced he is teaming up with a local garage — Calvin called it "this new venture"; the exchange included photos of a car being worked on in a garage (Dave's) and of a green car in a garage with a sign in the background (on Calvin's turn) [S5T1][S5T2].
- "Loving this job" — works with awesome mechanics and shares his knowledge about cars; shared a photo of a man working on a car engine in a garage and called the current project cool but a bit challenging [S5T3].
- For now, focused on continuing to work on the current project and assisting customers [S5T5].
- On 2023-05-16, told Calvin the shop had opened the previous week (~2023-05-08/14) and that he had invited friends over to celebrate — "it's been amazing"; he's "super stoked to share [his] passion and help out with folks' rides" and it has "been incredible so far" [S6T8]. Note this conflicts with the 2023-05-01 statement that the shop had already opened (see above); the later date is recorded as stated.
- On 2023-05-16, Calvin congratulated him on opening his own car shop ("Way to go, Dave!" — his excitement is contagious, "keep up the great work"); Dave thanked him, called it "quite a journey so far," and said he's excited to see what the future holds [S6T9][S6T10].
- As of 2023-05-31, had recently fixed a neighbor's car engine himself — the neighbor "had been having some trouble with the engine", which is now done; shared a photo of himself working on the car engine in a garage. (Calvin recognized the car as the one Dave had been fixing the engine of "for a friend.") [S7T2][S7T3].
- On 2023-10-15, told Calvin it's been "a crazy rollercoaster week": a competing car maintenance shop snagged a deal that Dave's shop had been trying to secure for months; he felt "kinda bummed out" and questioned whether his hard work is a waste — "I put in so much effort at work, but it feels like nothing. Am I wasting my time?"; Calvin encouraged him — "don't give up, keep pushing and believe in yourself. The payoff will be worth it." — and Dave said he's "gotta have faith and patience" and is "sure it's only a matter of time till things work out" [S23T1][S23T2][S23T3].
- On 2023-10-23, shared a photo of his garage (a garage with a bunch of tools hanging on the wall — "a little dirty, but everything is in its place") while telling Calvin that working on a car is his own outlet (details in the 2023-10-23 entry of ## Relationships and in ## Hobbies and sense of purpose) [S25T13].

- Shared a photo of himself standing in front of a car on a lift at the workshop [S13T1].
- Shared a photo of the "really thrilling part of the workshop" — a mechanic working on a car — saying "seeing the potential come to life is always satisfying" [S13T5].
- Current car project: has been doing engine swaps and suspension modifications, and is now learning body modifications; the project is giving a classic muscle car a modern twist — "a challenge but so fun" — and shared a photo of a silver Corvette parked in front of a building; Calvin praised the modern twist the silver finish gives [S13T7][S13T8].
- Later in the same 2023-08-11 conversation, Dave explained the project's goal: he wanted "a modern vibe but also that classic muscle car style", and is "really happy with it"; "It's all about those small details that make it unique and personalized", and the project is about showing his style — "it's like customizing a work of art on wheels"; Calvin praised the work and attention to detail ("You've really put in some work! That attention to detail is great"), agreed the small details are what make a masterpiece unique and personalized, and told Dave to "keep coming up with new cool stuff, bud", saying he's excited to see what Dave will do next [S13T9][S13T10][S13T11][S13T12][S13T13][S13T14].
- On 2023-08-14, told Calvin the project is "going great" and shared a photo of the car he's restoring (a car with a broken engine in the woods) — "It's pretty cool seeing it go from a beat-up mess to a real beauty." Calvin asked how long it would take to restore; Dave hopes it'll be all fixed up by the end of next month (end of September 2023): "Lots of elbow grease but it'll be worth the transformation." [S14T11][S14T12][S14T13]
- On 2023-09-15, told Calvin it's "been awesome": "Been restoring this vintage beauty" and shared the "final result" photo — a man standing next to a classic car — implying the restoration he had been updating Calvin on since 2023-08-14 (above) is now finished, ahead of his earlier hope (stated 2023-08-14) to have it done by the end of September 2023; Calvin: "Nice work, Dave! That looks amazing. Is it satisfying to see your hard work pay off?" [S19T7][S19T8]; Dave: "It's so satisfying to see this brought back to life," especially seeing people's reactions when they see the finished product — "makes all the hard work worth it" [S19T9].
- On 2023-09-22, reported a setback on the vintage Mustang (the restoration car he had been updating Calvin on — see above; he had shown the "final result" on 2023-09-15): he had been working on the engine and thought he'd fixed it, but when he started the car up he heard a weird noise — "So disappointing after putting so much work in"; shared a photo of the engine (a car engine with a small engine) and asked Calvin "Take a look at the engine!" [S20T1].
- On 2023-10-04, told Calvin he's been working on the Ford Mustang he found in a junkyard (the restoration car he has been updating Calvin on, see above) — "it was in bad shape, but I knew it had potential"; he said working on cars really helps him relax — "it's therapeutic to see them come back to life" — answering Calvin's question about what hobbies help him relax [S21T4].
- On 2023-10-04, after Calvin asked for pictures of the restoration looking amazing ("I'd love to see how it turned out!"), shared a photo of a red car parked in a field with other cars — "I put in a lot of work restoring it, but the result is awesome. It's so satisfying to bring an old car back to life." [S21T5][S21T6].

- On 2023-04-20, Dave offered to show him around Boston and take him to his favorite food spots; Calvin proposed meeting up for a meal when he is in Boston (details in the Boston trip section above) [S3T10][S3T15][S3T16].
- The 2023-04-20 conversation closed with both of them looking forward to the visit — Calvin said he can't wait to try the food with Dave, and Dave replied he can't wait to show Calvin the amazing music and food in Boston, signing off "See you soon!" [S3T17][S3T18].
- On 2023-05-01, congratulated Dave on opening his own car maintenance shop — "Congrats on achieving your dream", said his hard work and dedication paid off, praised Dave's "guts and ambition" and told him to "keep it up", was enthusiastic about Dave going after classic cars ("Fulfilling your dreams is so important"), and called the photo of the restored car's engine "awesome" (details on Dave's shop in /memories/dave.md > ## Car maintenance shop) [S4T2][S4T4][S4T6][S4T8].
- On 2023-05-01, said he'd love to check Dave's shop out sometime and asked what sort of cars he works on (Dave: all kinds, from regular maintenance to full restorations of classic cars) [S4T17][S4T18][S4T19].
- The 2023-05-01 conversation closed with Calvin praising Dave's work ("Keep up the great work!" / "Keep on keepin' on, bud!") after Dave said his work is valued and brings joy to others; Calvin then shared a photo of a gold necklace with a diamond pendant (see ## Jewelry) [S4T22][S4T23][S4T24].

- The 2023-05-16 exchange continued: Calvin congratulated Dave on the shop (see ## Car maintenance shop), and when Dave asked about Calvin's music, Calvin shared the upcoming Tokyo performance [S6T10][S6T11]; Dave said doing a show in Tokyo is "wow", was sure the audience would love it, and wished him luck — Calvin promised to keep him posted on how it goes [S6T12][S6T13]; when Calvin shared a photo of the Tokyo night skyline (taken 2023-05-15), Dave called it a great shot, said the night skyline "really pops with those city lights," and said he has to take a trip to Tokyo soon [S6T14][S6T15][S6T16]; after Calvin said the city lights in Tokyo are amazing and encouraged him to visit, Dave said he is "definitely adding it to [his] list" and thanked Calvin [S6T17][S6T18].
- The 2023-06-09 conversation continued: Calvin asked what was new and exciting for Dave, and Dave announced he booked a trip to a mountainous region for next month (July 2023) — "finally gonna be able to see those majestic peaks" (details in ## Mountain trip (July 2023)) [S8T10]. Calvin said he wants to go on a hike in the mountains to escape it all and de-stress — see /memories/calvin.md > ## Mountains and hiking [S8T9]. The two exchanged trip wishes and signed off "see you soon" [S8T11][S8T12][S8T13][S8T14].
- On 2023-06-21, Calvin told Dave about a car accident he had on 2023-06-16 (no one hurt); Dave expressed sympathy, asked whether the insurance process had any issues and how long it took to sort out, and asked about the mechanic in Calvin's garage photo. Details of the accident and repair are in /memories/calvin.md > ## Car accident (2023-06-16) [S9T2][S9T4][S9T6][S9T8].
- On 2023-06-21 (continuing the car-repair conversation), Dave said it's awesome that Calvin trusts the people fixing the car — "Sounds like they're doing a great job. It'll be back to normal soon!" [S9T10].
- On 2023-06-21, Calvin then shared a photo of a small-town view in Japan with a mountain in the background; Dave marveled at it — "I haven't seen anything like that before!" — asked where it was and whether Calvin has been there; Calvin said not yet, but it's on his to-do list for after the Frank Ocean tour — see /memories/calvin.md > ## Japan plan [S9T11][S9T12][S9T13][S9T14][S9T15].

- The 2023-07-21 conversation continued: Dave asked how Calvin deals with the pressure of his music and stays motivated; Calvin said collaborating with others, learning from them, and surrounding himself with positive energy helps; Dave encouraged him — surrounding himself with good vibes and collaborating "will give you a boost", "You've achieved so much so far; keep going, buddy!" (Calvin's motivation details in /memories/calvin.md > ## Music) [S11T9][S11T10][S11T11].
- The conversation closed with Calvin thanking Dave — his support "means a lot to me" — and saying he's gonna keep pushing himself and striving for his goals; Dave replied "You got this! Keep pushing yourself and never lose sight of your goals. I'm your biggest fan. Let's chat soon!", and Calvin said "Thanks, Dave! Appreciate your support. Let's catch up soon and chat. Take care!" [S11T12][S11T13][S11T14].
- On 2023-08-11, caught up with Calvin ("been ages!"): Dave announced he got picked for a car mod workshop (a dream come true — he's always wanted to learn auto engineering and to work on building a custom car) and shared photos of the cars he's working with (a man in front of a car on a lift; a mechanic working on a car; a silver Corvette) (details in ## Car mod workshop (2023-08-11)). Calvin congratulated him and asked about the transformations he'd done so far and how the current project is going, and praised the modern twist the silver finish gives [S13T1][S13T2][S13T3][S13T5][S13T6][S13T7][S13T8].
- The 2023-08-11 conversation continued: Dave said his current project combines "a modern vibe but also that classic muscle car style", that he's "really happy with it", that the small details are what "make it unique and personalized", and that customizing it is "like a work of art on wheels" (details in ## Car mod workshop (2023-08-11)); Calvin praised his attention to detail and encouraged him to keep coming up with new cool stuff [S13T9][S13T10][S13T11][S13T12][S13T13][S13T14]. Dave then offered Calvin a hand with his music stuff — his music studio has a high-quality sound system (details in ## Music); Calvin thanked him, said he's "super busy with my music stuff at the moment", and will keep the offer in mind — "Great work, dude!" [S13T15][S13T16].
- The 2023-08-11 conversation ended with Dave telling Calvin "No worries... Got it. Good luck with your music!"; Calvin thanked him for the encouragement and said he'll keep working hard and making music, and Dave signed off "See ya, Calvin! Stay awesome. Catch ya later." [S13T17][S13T18][S13T19].
- On 2023-08-14, reconnected with Calvin ("since last we talked"): Dave told him he got to go to a car workshop in San Francisco (details in ## Car workshops in San Francisco); Calvin: "That's awesome! Car workshops sound totally cool and inspiring. Glad you found something that really gets you going." [S14T1][S14T2]. Dave then asked what Calvin had been up to; Calvin told him the amazing experience of touring with the well-known artist — the tour ended with a show in Japan, and afterward he got to explore his new place (details in the Tokyo trip section of /memories/calvin.md). Dave bet playing for an eager audience was incredible and asked how Tokyo reacted to Calvin's music and about special moments; Calvin said the Tokyo show was "awesome" — the crowd sang along to one of his songs, "a magical moment" — and when Dave asked for pictures from the show, Calvin shared one (a crowd at the concert with their hands up), saying these moments are why he loves his job; Dave: "The energy in that pic is awesome! Seeing everyone with their hands up must have been really cool. It's great when your passion brings joy to others!" [S14T4][S14T5][S14T6][S14T7][S14T8][S14T9].
- The 2023-08-14 conversation continued: Dave told Calvin the car restoration is "going great" and shared a photo of it (details in ## Car mod workshop (2023-08-11)); Calvin predicted it "is going to look amazing when you're done" and asked how long it would take. Dave said Calvin's support "means a lot to [him]" [S14T11][S14T12][S14T13][S14T15].
- The 2023-08-14 conversation closed with Calvin cheering Dave on — "You got this, Dave! I'm always here for you. Seeing your enthusiasm is amazing. Keep growing, buddy. It'll be worth it! Good luck with that. See ya!" — after Calvin said Dave "has some serious talent" and he was "really excited to see the end result of [Dave's] hard work" [S14T14][S14T16].
- On 2023-08-22, reconnected with Calvin ("Haven't talked in a while!"): Dave shared that he'd had a card night with friends on 2023-08-18 (details in ## Card night (2023-08-18)); Calvin told him he scored a deal to continue collaborating with Frank Ocean — "a dream come true" — and Dave: "Wow Calvin, congrats! Super excited for you." and asked how the chance came up; Calvin explained that he met Frank at a music festival in Tokyo, they clicked, and they recorded a song in Calvin's mansion studio; Dave: "Wow, Tokyo sounds like an incredible experience!" and asked what it was like playing at the festival; Calvin described the buzzing energy, the lively crowd, and "We all felt connected, it was amazing!", sharing a photo of the crowd sitting on the grass at night (Calvin's side in the Frank Ocean collaboration section of /memories/calvin.md) [S15T1][S15T2][S15T3][S15T4][S15T5][S15T6][S15T7][S15T8].
